marc:datafield.marc:subfield: The virtual revolution how is the internet changing our lives?

"This BAFTA Award winning series brings together everyone who's anyone on the web, from its inventor Tim Berners-Lee to Facebook founder Mark Zuckerberg, Wikipedia's Jimmy Wales to Amozon's Jeff Bezos, and online giants AlGore and Bill Gates. Investigating online sensations such as Google, Amazon, Twitter, Wikipedia and YouTube, technology journalist Aleks Krotoski discovers how big companies make money from free space, what is happening to uur ideas of privacy and ownership, and how social networking is affecting our psychology."--Container
